{{Top|leg}}
'''Button beetles''' were animals of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] that ate the nectar of [[nebula orchid]]s.

[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] once found a nest of polished button beetles under the ruins of the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]]. They came in various [[Color/Legends|colors]].
